description.name: Dual Awoken Cry Mode I (Porom)
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 White Magic abilities, grants [HP Stock (500)]/[HP Stock (1000)]/[HP Stock (1500)]/[HP Stock (2000)]/[HP Stock (3000)] to all allies after using White Magic abilities at rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Dual Awoken Cry Mode II (Porom)

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
